articleTitle: Construction of boundary operators for the laplacian. 1. Using of simple layer potential
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory

articleTitle: Body shape reconstruction from scattering patterns at resonant frequencies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The paper develops a method of body shape reconstruction based on the property that a set of scattering patterns, measured at a resonant frequency of inner domain, is noncomplete. The method consists in numerical determination of the orthogonal complement function which generates some auxiliary real field, one of zero lines of which is the sought body contour. The variational technique is used. The method is transferred onto the case of uniformly moving body. Numerical results for two-dimensional model problems concerning the pencil- and kite-shaped bodies are presented. They show, in particular, that for reconstruction of complicated shapes the measurements should be made at higher resonant frequencies.

articleTitle: Axial symmetric electromagnetic excitation of a finite conical screen by the ring sources (comparison of TE- and TM- wave scattering characteristics)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The axial-symmetric TE- and TM- waves scattering by the finite perfectly conducting cone is investigated. The characteristics of the far field pattern and the normalized radiation power of the ring sources located above the conical screen are studied. The comparison of the physical effects connected with electromagnetic wave radiation by the electric and magnetic rings are carried out.

articleTitle: Wiener-Hopf analysis of the elastic wave diffraction by the finite crack located at the plane interface between the elastic isotropic half-space medium
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: In this paper we have analyzed the SH elastic wave diffraction by the finite crack located at the plane interface between two perfectly welded materials rigorously. The incident field is taken as a plane wave. Introducing the Fourier transform of the scattered field and applying boundary conditions in the transform domain, the problem is formulated in the terms of the Wiener-Hopf equation. An approximate solution of such equation is proposed and numerical calculation examples for displacement patterns are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Inverse problem solution for layered dielectric structures using rational interpolation method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: An opportunity of using the rational representation of reflection characteristics in the spectral conjugate domain for determination of parameters of layered dielectric structures has been considered. The algorithm of rational interpolation providing steady estimates is presented. The accuracy properties of proposed method are analysed.

articleTitle: Comparision of two optimization criteria in antenna problems with free phase pattern
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Two criteria of antenna synthesis by the amplitude radiation pattern are compared. They use the reactive power and weighted current norm, respectively, both supplying the mean square difference between the desired and obtained amplitude patterns. The technique based on the generating polynomial concept is applied to nonlinear integral equations in both eases. Numerical results are presented.

articleTitle: Construction of boundary operators for the laplacian. 11. Using of double layer potential
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory

articleTitle: Averaged SAR distributions and temperature rise estimatton in child head model with 835MHZ handset phone
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The Brooks visible Human model downscaled to a 10 years old child size, exposed to a mobile Phone operating at 835 MHz is studied. Using a custom program, based on the Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD) method, point SAR as well as 1g and lOg averaged SAR values are compared to the results obtained using a commercial FDTD program. Temperature rise in the child head model under analysis for 0.6W output power is investigated using the Bio Heat equation.

articleTitle: Time-domain methods in problems of model synthesis of microwave power compressors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory

articleTitle: Innovative approaches to parallelizing finite-difference time-domain computations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: We investigate the Linux implementation of the finite-difference time- domain (FDTD) algorithm on a Beowulf cluster of parallel workstations. We discuss synchronization and domain decomposition alternatives. To obtain performance characteristics the algorithm is applied to a test scattering problem. The computation has been done using varying numbers of identical dual-processor AMD Athlon MP- 1800 workstations with the Message Passing Interface (MPI) used to handle the inter- processor communications and the parallel runtime.

articleTitle: Sound radiation by rotating porous cylinder
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The two-dimension problem of sound radiation from the porous circular cylinder saturated by a liquid and rotating around its axis of symmetry is investigated. For the description of the dynamical state of the porous cylinder the Bowen's theory is used, in accordance of which the porosity is introduced as the inner parameter, satisfying the equation of the evolution type. The numerical example for a case of sandy cylinder, saturated by the kerosene, rotating in air is considered.

articleTitle: Numerical solving of two-dimensional nonlinear spectral problem arising in antenna synthesis with flat radiating aperture
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Two various approaches to solving of two-dimensional nonlinear spectral problem arising at researching the branching of the solutions of nonlinear synthesis problems with flat radiating aperture, are stated. The numerical examples of finding of eigenvalues for the case of flat rectangular aperture, are given.

articleTitle: Development of simulation model for shielded twisted pair cables in EMC immunity problems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The aim of this work is development and validation of the robust model suitable for analysis of the immunity and radiation problems of the shielded twisted pair cables. A model is based on the method of moments (MoM) considerations and is used for the simulations of shielded cables in TEM cell, where simulation results are compared with measurement data.

articleTitle: The near zone fields and polarization characteristics of crossed impedance vibrators over perfect conducting plane
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The investigations of distribution of the near zone electromagnetic fields and polarization characteristics of the thin crossed impedance vibrators situated over the infinite perfect conducting plane have been made. The possibility of creation of the radiated field of circular (elliptic) polarization at the expense of a definite value and a type of surface impedance of every from vibrators is shown.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of complicated electromagnetic systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Main reliability characteristics of complicated electromagnetic systems are examined in this paper. A method of investigation of reliability parameters of complicated systems by means of generating functions is developed taking account of aging of the system's output elements. Expressions for the failure probability, the failure frequency and the failure rate are worked out in the cases when the lifetime of ageing output elements is circumscribed by the Rayleigh distribution.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic waves in isotropic waveguide filled by radially non-uniform dissipative plasma
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: This report is devoted to the investigation of the influence of effective collision electron frequency and plasma density radial non-uniformity on the phase characteristics, spatial attenuation and wave field structure of slow symmetric electromagnetic waves that propagate along cylindrical waveguide structure. The waveguide structure consists of radially non-uniform column of isotropic plasma that is surrounded by the dielectric and placed in metallic waveguide. We have shown that both collision frequency and density non-uniformity affect the wave characteristics and consequently, on the parameters of gas discharge sustained by this wave.

articleTitle: Iterative process for a problem of elastic disturbance propagation in un-uniformly strained semi-space
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: An iterative method for solving of an initial-boundary value problem for solving of the system of hyperbolic equations with variable coeffcients describing elastic disturbance propagation in strained solids is considered. Conditions of convergence of the iterative process are established.

articleTitle: Scattering of H-polarized electromagnetic wave by a dihedral wedge with a solid cylinder with a sectoral groove at the apex
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The rigorous solution of the problem is presented. Relying upon completeness of angular functions on the respective intervals the boundary-value method is applied. SFF and BRCS of the structure are evaluated asymptotically. The scattered field characteristics are analyzed numerically with controlled precision. Shown that BRCS as function of incident wave length exhibits oscillating character, with sectoral groove presence having significant effect on the shape of the resulting radiation-pattern which also varies with the sector opening angle.

articleTitle: Optimization strategy for multiport waveguide junctions with canonical types of artificial discontinuities
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The rigorous theories are generalized to analyze H-plane waveguide junctions with canonical types of discontinuities. A strategy of optimising parameters of such discontinuities is given and numerically illustrated. Analysis of the scattering characteristics of waveguide tee with strip discontinuities is done, and optimal parameters of these discontinuities are predicted.

articleTitle: Spectral characteristics of wave process in circular cylinder rotated in acoustical medium with a non- constant angular velocity
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The plane strain of an elastic circular cylinder of infinite length rotated about its axis with a non-uniform angular velocity in an ideal compressible non-viscous fluid (gas) is studied. The spectral characteristics for the elastic displacement and stresses for the case of the Armco iron cylinder immersed in the water are analyzed.

articleTitle: Susceptibility and effects of the resonant scattering of intensive fields by weakly nonlinear dielectric layer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The transverse non-homogeneous, isotropic, nonmagnetic, linearly polarized, weakly nonlinear (a Kerr-like dielectric nonlinearity) dielectric layer is considered. The results of the numerical analysis of the diffraction problem of a plane wave on the weakly nonlinear object at positive and negative value of the susceptibility are shown. The effects: non-uniform shift of resonant frequency of the diffraction characteristics of a weakly nonlinear dielectric layer; itself the channelling of a field - increase of the angle of the transparency of the nonlinear layer when growth of intensity of the field (at positive value of the susceptibility); dechannelling of a field (at negative value of the susceptibility) are found out.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field in rectangular waveguide with magnetized fractal ferrite plate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The investigation results of electromagnetic field in rectangular waveguide with cross magnetized fractal ferrite plate have been showed. The apparatus of fractional integro-differential calculus has been used to find /spl alpha/ characteristics of the field components in presented medium. The dependence of transversal and longitudinal field components on values of scaling index which characterizes the degree of fractal ferrite filling has been determined.

articleTitle: Understanding the beam area at quantum level using string theory
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: One of the most important and root basic of communication technology is the antenna parameter, called the beam area or the beam solid angle. Since communications can be related in every way to light and the Maxwell equations, it is very apparent that string theory with its concepts of D-branes and quantum oscillators can help in the understanding the antenna parameter at a quantum level. This paper is based on this very aspect of string theory, and proceeds to bring out a relation of the beam area in terms of string parameters.

articleTitle: On the theory of a spherical radome
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Approximate electrodynamic theory of a spherical radome of an antenna is suggested, when inside of it close to its center is placed a dipole. Calculating formula of the power radiated in far zone is received. Conditions, at which this power reaches its maximal value, are considered. For the width of the dielectric layer of the radome these conditions give transcendental equation, which may be solved by graphical method for fixed values of the wavelength and dielectric permittivity of the spherical layer of the radome. Examples of calculation of geometric dimensions of the radome are presented.

articleTitle: Metallic photonic crystal filters design with MMP methods
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: An ultra-compact metallic photonic crystal filter for telecommunication wavelength is designed using the Multiple Multipole Program combined with the Model-Based Parameter Estimation technique. Material loss is taken into account and measured data is employed to make this design more realistic. Finally, deterministic optimization techniques are applied for obtaining the desired filter characteristics.

articleTitle: Numerical and experimental investigation of dielectric coated personal communication systems (PCS) antenna
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: We are continuing investigation of dielectric coated personal communication systems (PCS) antennas, presented a pear-shaped antenna with optimal geometric size and shape to provide desirable electric and radiation characteristics; sophisticated user-friendly program package for simulation and visualization of dielectric coated antennas with required parameters, investigated the directed antenna radiation and conducted necessary measurements using network analyzer and anechoic chamber provided with equipment for measurement of antenna patterns. The Method of Auxiliary Sources (MAS) is used for obtaining accurate results at low computational costs. Some numerical and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Effective material parameters of dielectric layer with metal periodic array
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The problem of effective material parameter deriving of homogeneous layer is considered to obtain exactly the same complex transmission and reflection coefficients of normal incident plane wave as ones are produced by metal periodic array placed on the surface of dielectric substrate.

articleTitle: The calculation method of reflectarray of microstrip radiators
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The method of a calculation of a current phase increment in a microstrip antenna in comparison with an incident field phase and accordingly of a field phase step in a signal reradiation by a reflectarray element is offered. The field phase step depending on an antenna length, reactive stub dimensions and a capacity of the condenser, formed by a slot, cut in an antenna, is calculated.

articleTitle: Scattering of high-frequency wave by a thin-walled plane rigidly supported inclusion
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: A thin plane rigidly supported inclusion is in a uniform background (in two-dimensional Euclidean space) and subjected to an incident plane harmonic wave. The related mixed boundary-value problem is formulated as a matrix Wiener-Hopf equation which is solved through the Khrapkov method.

articleTitle: Development of FEM/MOM approach for investigation of vehicle glass antennas
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The aim of this work is development of robust model suitable for analysis of automobile glass antennas. The model is based on FEM/MOM (Finite Element Method combined with Method of Moments) considerations for effective and accurate solution and reflects the latest improvements and modifications to EMAP5 [l],[2],[3]. Appropriate changes on pre-processing stage are performed in order to reflect data flow peculiarities in the automotive industry. Performance of the solver is improved because of usage sophisticated matrix solver. Some examples are provided to demonstrate the capability of modeling and to compare calculation time with those obtained original EMAP5.

articleTitle: Modeling of EM waves for simplified cases of urban and terrain areas by method of auxiliary sources
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: This article concerns some realistic scenarios for evaluation of the EM field and for better comprehension of its behavior indoors, outdoors and terrain areas having a place nearby of base stations [H. Lehmann et al., 2003]. Based on the method of auxiliary sources the new approaches are presented in case of problems with the electrically large objects using reasonable computational resources and keeping acceptable accuracy [R. Zaridze et al., January 2002]. Three general scenarios are marked. First, the finding of field distribution indoor, without influence of outside objects. Second considers the field distribution near the wall with finite sizes when effect of ground is taken into account. Third is the finding of the field distribution near mountains or hills. These scenarios are an integral part of all cities and consequently are taken for consideration. Corresponding results are presented below.

articleTitle: Numerical solution of an integral equation for electromagnetic field in conductive medium with crack
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory

articleTitle: Dielectric heating with electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The problem of heating of a semi-infinite dielectric with dependent on temperature electrical parameters by electromagnetic field is solved in WKB approximation. New analytical solution for the temperature distribution inside of a dielectric is found for one case of nonlinear dependence of dielectric losses on temperature.

articleTitle: Numerical and analytical study of the behavior of the HF electromagnetic field on the surface of the thin layer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: In this work, we present a method of calculation of the high frequency electromagnetic field at the surface of a massive screen. This method is based on a formulation in magnetic potential vector by considering the quasi stationary harmonic mode. We used the finite element method to solve the problem in the structure and the method of integrals of border in the external medium which extends ad infinitum. The coupling of the two methods of calculation utilizes fictitious surface currents. What makes it possible to represent the numerical values of the fields. The representation of the latter according to the characteristics of the system constitutes information on the electromagnetic energy transmitted through the screen.

articleTitle: About one bilateral approximation method of determination of the branching points of nonlinear integral equation arising in the theory of antennas synthesis
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The problem of construction of numerical bilateral approximation for determination of branching points of one nonlinear integral operator, arising in the theory of antennas synthesis according to the given amplitude directivity pattern, is considered. The basic difficulty consists in that the kernel of integral operator nonlinearly depends on the parameter, which play role of the spectral one. Thus the problem is reduced to a nonlinear eigenvalue problem with application the technique of the alternating approximations of eigenvalues. The technique is based on a generalization of the known Rayleigh ratio for iinear problem onto nonlinear (initial and some auxiliary) eigenvalue problems. These generalized Rayleigh ratioes are used for constructing an iterative process of alternating eigenvalue approximations.

articleTitle: Relativistic rotation and classic electrodynamics validity limit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: As it is known the limit of applicability of classical electrodynamics (ED) is limited with so called electron's classical radius Rcl/spl sim/elmc/sup 2/. This estimation appears in the several totally different approaches to the problem with one common assumption, that electron has a finite size. It is necessary to specify that there is no consecutive and strict account of the relativistic rotational movement's contribution into the calculation of energy and angular momentum of the researched objects. Such omission is that the contribution in cross section of EM waves scattering on the magnetic moment of electron can be neglected, while it is not correct for relativistic velocities. In this paper it is shown that the removal of such omission (in the context of strict relativistic description) leads to the possibility of obtaining the correct limit of applicability of classic Rcl/spl sim/h/mc.

articleTitle: About local properties of gradient method for free phase problem with isometric operator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Variational problem on pseudo-solutions of the free phase equation an isometric operator in Hilbert spaces is considered. Local relaxation property of the gradient method and weak convergence are proven.

articleTitle: Investigation of the biological objects by scattered waves
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory

articleTitle: Methodology of determination of B-media parameters through the investigation of scattered EM fields
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: In this paper, the problem of material parameters determination of metamaterials is discussed. The overview for the theoretical base of metamaterials is introduced and software is presented, along with some particular results of numerical evaluations.

articleTitle: Efficient field solvers for the analysis of photonic crystal filters
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: An efficient method for the accurate conputation of the response of photonic crystal filters is obtained from a combination of the Model-Based Parameter Estimation (MBPE) technique with accurate field solvers such as the Multiple Multipole Program (MMP) or the Method of Auxiliary Sources (MAS). When metals are present in such filters, strong material dispersion at optical frequencies causes nonlinearity of the filter respose. It is demonstrated that the technique remains accurate when the frequency range is subdivided into pieces with moderate dispersion. Excellent agreement of MMP-MBPE and MAS-MBPE with a commercial time domain solver is demonstrated

articleTitle: Qualitative analysis of precise frequency multiplier of harmonic oscillations
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Stability of discrete algorithm of precise frequency multiplier is investigated. It is shown analytically that the algorithm of frequency multiplier is numerically stable one if the step of discretization satisfies certain constraints. A sensitivity of output signals of frequency multiplier model to parameters values change by direct evaluations of output signals deviations depending on model parameters variations from desired values is analysed by numerical method. It is obtained that the multipliers should have high precision values of parameters that can be guaranteed by modern hardware, specifically built on logarithmic circuits. A comparison with existing analogs has been made. Simulation example and the corresponding results are also provided.

articleTitle: The method of antenna directivity calculation on the basis of main patterns
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: For an evaluation of antenna directivity it is necessary to know the three-dimensional antenna patterns. As a rule, antenna patterns are measured only in two main planes: horizontal and vertical. In this paper the method of antenna directivity calculation on the basis of main patterns will be considered.

articleTitle: A cost comparison of the ellipsoidal acoustic infinite element method and the spherical acoustic infinite element method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: A cost comparison of the ellipsoidal acoustic infinite element method (EAIEM)and the spherical acoustic infinite element method (SAIEM) is discussed by converting the calculational cost of infinite elements into that of finite elements. Compares to the EAIEM, the advantage of the SAIEM is evident when the dimensionless frequency is less than 10 or the ratio of the length to the width of the acoustic source is less than 10, even if using the EAIEM reduces the number of finite elements between the acoustic source and the artificial boundary. The advantage of the EAIEM is more and more remarkable as the dimensionless frequency and the ratio of the length to the width of the acoustic source increase. The efficiency and the precision of the EAIEM should be researched further to reach the highest potential of the EAIEM.

articleTitle: Semiasymptotic method for plane with quasiperiodic spatial perturbation of gyrotropic surface impedance
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Phenomena of coupling of wave beams and surface wave at impedance plane with spatially oscillating parameters are theoretically considered. Used method is asymptotic with respect to smoothness parameter and is numerical with respect to perturbation amplitudes. It combinesadvantages of the asymptotic and numeric methods in cases of quasiperiodic structures with large number of "periods". Coupling coefficients are obtained for complex amplitude of resonance harmonic. Nonreciprocal Bragg phenomena are analyzed.

articleTitle: Operator method in the problem of wave diffraction by flat semi-infinite strip grating
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The electromagnetic (EM) wave scattering by a flat semi-infinite grating (SIG) of metal strips is studied by the operator method. The nonlinear equation in terms of the operator of reflection from SIG is built using the translation property of a periodical SIG. The approximate analytical solution at the assumption that strips are narrow and spaced sparsely is obtained by the steepest-descent method. This representation can be used as the initial approach for an iteration procedure of the numerical solution in general case.

articleTitle: Simulation of EM scattering on open surfaces by method of auxiliary sources
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The adaptation of MAS (Method of Auxiliary Sources) for problems of scattering in case of open surfaces is presented. Proposed algorithmis implemented for simple flat PEC and curved plates. Results obtained by this procedure are presented and also compared with Method of Moment (MoM).

articleTitle: Synthesis of the circular array in the given range of frequencies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: The synthesis problem according to the prescribed amplitude radiation pattern in the range of frequencies is considered. The variational approach for the statement of synthesis problem is used. The mean-square deviation of prescribed and synthesized amplitude radiation patterns is minimized. The results of usual and frequency-dependent synthesis are comprised.

articleTitle: Special ditch for solid-state waveguide, multielement laser (SWMEL)
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory

articleTitle: Periodically non-stationary random processes modeling: Approach on the basis of harmonic representation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Theoretical and experimental results of time series modeling are summarized. Special attention is given to periodically correlated random processes (PCRP). It is suggested to use the parametric modeling methods on the basis of PCRP decomposition on stationary processes for construction of the process model. Proposed parametrical model is helpful for veriflcation the efficiency of devices and systems with periodical character of sources.

articleTitle: Microstrip array in open resonator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of Xth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory
abstract: Possibility of excitation of the lowest mode oscillations in a semi-symmetric open resonator (OR) using 4 element microstrip array (MSA) is examined. MSA properties at 10 GHz frequency are calculated. Experimental curves of loaded Q-quality and resonant gain as a function of distance between the mirrors of the OR, excited by the MSA, and an aperture coupling component are shown. Promising application of the MSA in creating active high-Q quasi-optic wave generator in the millimeter (mm) range is shown. The aim of this paper is the calculation and analysis of the electrodynamical characteristics of an OR with MSA, consisting of four identical rectangular patches excited in phase.
